statement: For every finite simple undirected connected graph G with at least two vertices, under the standard simultaneous-spread graph-burning convention and the standard Roman dominating-function definition fixed in problem.md, 2b(G)-2 <= gamma_R(G).
contribution: A complete proof of the frozen machine-generated survivor. The proof chooses a minimum Roman dominating function with the fewest 1-labels, proves that its 1-set is independent and anticomplete to its 2-set, and converts the resulting distance-two structure into a legal burning process of length at most floor(gamma_R(G)/2)+1. This makes no claim of literature priority beyond resolving the precise frozen problem; its prior open/novel status remains uncertain.
